info.prerequisite: Passed EAW221 or EAW222 or EAW301
info.description:
Objectives:
The course is designed to help undergraduate students enhance their business communication via authentic and various written forms such as emails, cover letters, and CVs. With practical tips and detailed guidelines, students will be able to write more effectively and appropriately in business contexts, assuring success in delivering key messages.
Additionally, students will be introduced and guided to use AI-powered writing assistants (such as ChatGPT, Grammarly, QuillBot, Microsoft Copilot, and Google Gemini) to support drafting, revising, and analyzing business texts. This helps them leverage technology effectively while maintaining critical judgment and ethical awareness in professional communication.
Description
ENB302 addresses a wide-ranging spectrum of business communication with the straightforward seven-step method. These easy-to-follow steps save students time from start to finish, and helpful checklists will boost their confidence in business writing. Students will learn to promote themselves and their ideas clearly and concisely―whether putting together a persuasive project proposal or dealing with daily email. The course also provides comprehensive examples for all the most popular forms of communication, including slide presentations, résumés, cover letters, web copy, and a thorough guide to the art of crafting e-mails and instant messages. Insightful sidebars from experts in various fields demystify the skills of self-editing, creating content, and overcoming writer’s block, and the author’s reference-ready resources on style, punctuation, and grammar will keep students' writing error-free.
In addition, the course integrates the use of widely accessible AI tools in Vietnam (e.g., ChatGPT, Grammarly, QuillBot, Microsoft Copilot, and Google Gemini) to enhance writing efficiency, provide instant feedback, and encourage reflective learning. This integration equips students with digital literacy, critical awareness, and ethical understanding of how to use AI responsibly in business communication.
Teaching Methods:
The teaching & learning process includes a variety of methods:
From teachers’ side: lectures, guided learning, feedback and corrections; From students’ side: discussions, reading, research, writing and self-study.
To complement these, students will also engage in AI-assisted writing practice (e.g., drafting, paraphrasing, and self-editing with ChatGPT, Grammarly, QuillBot, or Gemini) and AI-supported peer review, ensuring they experience both traditional and technology-enhanced approaches to business writing.
---------------------------------------------------------
AI TOOLS:
1. AI Tools for Brainstorming, Drafting, and Content Generation
- ChatGPT – used to brainstorm ideas, generate topic outlines, draft professional emails, and create first versions of business documents such as cover letters, proposals, and reports.
- Microsoft Copilot – assists in drafting content directly within Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, or Outlook, providing context-aware suggestions, formatting, and summaries.
- Google Gemini – supports brainstorming and idea organization by offering multi-modal inputs (text, image, and document-based prompts) for business-related writing topics.
2. AI Tools for Revising, Paraphrasing, and Improving Style
- Grammarly – helps students check grammar, punctuation, tone, and clarity, ensuring their writing is professional and audience-appropriate.
- QuillBot – assists with paraphrasing, rewording, and sentence restructuring to enhance coherence and fluency.
- ChatGPT – supports self-editing by providing real-time suggestions for improving tone, structure, and logical flow in business texts.
3. AI Tools for Analyzing and Reflecting on Writing Quality
- Grammarly – provides analytics on readability, tone, and engagement, helping students evaluate the clarity and appropriateness of their business communication.
- QuillBot – allows students to compare original and revised versions to understand how language choices affect clarity and professionalism.
- Google Gemini / Microsoft Copilot – support text summarization and feedback generation for reflective learning activities.
- ChatGPT – can be used for AI-supported peer review, where students analyze sample texts or each other’s drafts using guided prompts.
4. AI Tools for Ethical and Responsible Writing Practices
All tools (ChatGPT, Grammarly, QuillBot, Copilot, Gemini) – are integrated under ethical guidelines.
Students are taught:
- how to verify AI-generated content for accuracy,
- how to maintain originality and academic honesty, and
- how to apply critical thinking when accepting or rejecting AI suggestions.
Assessment scheme:
1) On-going assessment
- Assignment 01*20% 20%
- Progress Tests 02*20% 40%
2) Final Examination: 01*40% 40%
3) Final Result 100%
4) Completion Criteria:
a) On-going assessment >0, Each component >0
b) Final Examination >=4
c) Final Result >=5

clos.loDetails:
Write effective and appropriate business emails using professional structure, tone, and clarity. Apply AI tools to draft, refine, and check email content for conciseness, politeness, and appropriateness across business situations. (SKILLS)
LO2.1 Identify the essential elements and structure of professional emails.
LO2.2 Apply key tips for clear, concise, and professional email writing.
LO2.3 Compose effective and appropriate business emails for various purposes using AI support where appropriate.

Write professional CVs and cover letters that highlight relevant skills and achievements. Apply AI tools (e.g., Grammarly, QuillBot, ChatGPT, Copilot, or Gemini) to generate drafts, receive feedback, and improve clarity, persuasiveness, and language accuracy. (SKILLS)
LO3.1 Write professional CVs (résumés) that highlight relevant skills and achievements.
LO3.2 Write tailored and persuasive cover letters for specific job applications with AI-supported review and enhancement.

Write clear and concise business memos using the correct structure and tone. Apply AI tools to analyze memo organization, coherence, and tone to ensure professional workplace communication. (SKILLS)
LO4.1 Identify the structure and format of a standard business memo.
LO4.2 Apply key principles and tips for writing clear and concise memos.
LO4.3 Compose effective and appropriate memos for workplace communication using AI-assisted drafting or proofreading.

Improve clarity, accuracy, and professionalism in business writing through self-editing and AI-supported feedback. Apply AI tools to overcome writer’s block, refine tone and style, and check for grammatical or lexical errors. (SKILLS)
LO5.1 Overcome writer’s block and build confidence in business writing using AI brainstorming tools.
LO5.2 Use appropriate tone, style, and register in professional contexts.
LO5.3 Avoid common grammatical and lexical errors in business writing with AI-assisted correction.
LO5.4 Edit and proofread written texts to ensure accuracy and coherence, applying AI feedback critically.

Develop professional attitudes toward responsible and ethical business communication, including the appropriate and transparent use of AI-assisted writing tools. (ATTITUDES: Professional Ethics & Responsibility)
LO6.1 Recognize ethical and privacy concerns when using AI tools in writing.
LO6.2 Demonstrate respect for academic and professional integrity in AI-supported tasks.
LO6.3 Apply responsible judgment to balance efficiency and originality in business writing.

Utilize AI-powered writing assistants (ChatGPT, Grammarly, QuillBot, Microsoft Copilot, and Google Gemini) to improve drafting, revising, and self-evaluation of business documents. Apply AI critically for reflective learning and continuous improvement. (SKILLS: Digital Literacy & Reflective Learning)
LO7.1 Use AI tools to generate, revise, and proofread drafts of business documents.
LO7.2 Analyze AI feedback to improve coherence, tone, and clarity in business writing.
LO7.3 Reflect on personal writing progress through comparison between human and AI-assisted revisions.

Demonstrate understanding and application of the seven-step method in business writing. Apply AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or Google Gemini) to analyze, generate, and refine business texts following the seven-step writing framework. (KNOWLEDGE)
LO1.1 Get the ask clear.
LO1.2 Write for the reader.
LO1.3 Start the writing strong and specific.
LO1.4 Keep the writing concise.
LO1.5 Fill in missing content and remove extraneous content.
LO1.6 Write in plain English.
LO1.7 Fix wrong or irrelevant information or content.
